character_reference: a tall, lean man with messy dark hair, wearing a worn charcoal-grey tactical jacket with glowing amber circuitry patterns running down his sleeves
story_so_far: After decrypting Commander Vance's files and surviving a brutal clash in the subterranean facility, Kael followed a mysterious distress signal into an abandoned metro tunnel. Discovering a dormant army of branded drones, he triggered a magnetic trap and realized Vance is merely a pawn in a much larger, shadowed conspiracy.
